constraints: BB-155 must be DELIVERED before migration execution begins.

Migration must fail before authority switch if any unfinished Work cannot be transformed or if parity/next-action verification differs.

Canonical direct dependency remains BB-155; this chooses the explicitly recommended safe 155 ->157 ->156 deployment order, not a new graph edge. Research READY is not runtime capability delivery.

architectureDecisions: D1 — Pinned delivered BB-155+BB-157 V2_SUPERVISION_V1 runtime; base Work wire/CAS/clock/fence stay intact. Profile/digest check before freeze. READY plans are design inputs, not runtime delivery.

D2 — Prepare pinned selector-aware public controller/CLI/CI/bootstrap before flip. Refuse wrong/unreachable authority or unsupported protocol, no cwd/Git fallback. Only bounded immutable source archive supplies historical import proofs; no postflip current graph reader.

D3 — Admission quiesce precedes hard freeze: finish existing source publications with main writable, prove zero active legacy claims/callbacks; then maintenance+native main lock and fresh SHA recheck. Failed drain/race aborts. No Git/SQLite shared transaction or forged claim clearing.

D4 — Manifest includes all status!=DONE except exact valid BLOCKED withdrawal. Ordinary BLOCKED stays. Prove unique/disjoint exhaustive id partition and complete regular-file closure. Reject ambiguous withdrawal, missing refs and dangling/withdrawn dependency; never use a fixed count.

D5 — Exact transformBlueprint Work wire, generation/RV1; preserve ids, inline bodies/hashes, edges/components/scopes and phase authority. DONE uses external validated Living bindings only. Preserve/hash-pin existing isolated V2 set. importAuthorityRef proof never masquerades as a native Decision.

D6 — Original archived assertReady/validateEvaluation must pass. Typed immutable importAuthorityRef maps equal gen1 semantics/version refs, never rewrites answers/cacheKey or impersonates Decision. Pending judgment owns a real new read-only controller claim; no invented result/legacy lease. Unused stale EXECUTION candidates stay diagnostic.

D7 — Independent archived legacy guards versus actual native nextActions/buildContext on prepared snapshot. Compare diagnostics, proposed actions/required inputs and enabled mutation separately per parityBlueprint.algorithmSteps. Research claim may run ahead; Worker claim needs readiness/deps. VERIFY_MERGE is read-only; store publication is PUBLISH_DELIVERY_RECEIPT only with verified proof.

D8 — Exactly all included ids once, zero per-field diffs in canonical parity report. Compare semantic inputs/edges/scopes/blockers and native action guards; explicit CAS/fence/transport refinements never erase authority. Bind report to manifest/controller/destination.

D9 — One guarded BEGIN IMMEDIATE creates all real native records and target selectors privately, computes actual same-connection exhaustive parity, then report/receipt/allocator COMMIT. Failure rolls back all; WAL readers see old state until commit. This resolves store-clock claim identity without partial cutover.

D10 — Public wrappers route current Work only to pinned service; raw legacy-current APIs reject before I/O. No fallback/dual-write. Immutable historical proofs remain data; release main freeze only after every id and public surface verifies.

D11 — Select safer operational155->157->156 profile. No optional verification command: source collector executes every command. Exact BB-157 failure/reflection/lease subjects must preserve legal authority or migration fails. Missing applicable reflection cannot be manufactured; legitimate source resolution precedes a new snapshot.

D12 — Owned fixtures exercise all exports/checks without live cutover. Preserve independent judge, negative bindings and exact merge/tree/Living trust. Actual delivery requires real frozen cutover proof.
implementationSlices: S0 — Approve/merge evaluated candidate and install pinned routing while LEGACY; valid source graph and activation-conditional docs. Follow migrationContract.stages.

S1 — Quiesce in two stages: pause NEW legacy claims, allow existing normal publications on unlocked main to complete; prove zero active legacy claim/provider callback. Then hard service maintenance+native main lock, recapture/recheck source main/complete closure/destination hash. Capture every unfinished/nonwithdrawn item; race/drain/lock failure aborts and restores precommit gates. No fake claim clearing; existing isolated V2 set remains hash-bound during hard barrier.

S2 — transformLegacyWork + work-resource/import resolver: emit exact transformBlueprint wire and native immutable records, no spec.scopes or bridge-as-Decision. Validate original readiness/candidate through unchanged trusted legacy validators. Create typed gen1 importAuthorityRef proof with equal semantic projections and original hashes. DONE edges resolve Living proofs; pending judgment gets a real read-only controller Attempt/lease, no old live lease or invented result. Invalid phase/reflection aborts. Persist originalExpectedInput and source/receipt blob records at prepare/import; postflip resolution never invokes graph discovery or legacy current context.

S3 — Independent archived legacy projection first. Actual V2 parity runs INSIDE uncommitted import transaction after real native records/clock/fence claims exist, using same-connection readSnapshot and delivered native nextActions/buildContext. Compare post-barrier-release projections only for analysis; actual apply stays frozen. phaseRows defines actions/guards; preserve raw ids/refinements, scopes/blockers/proof hashes. Unknown/diff/expired lease rolls back all; no fake-clock/template oracle.

S4 — commitMigration performs cutoverContract: one guarded BEGIN IMMEDIATE creates rows/records/selectors privately, calls S3 exact native parity, then report/receipt/allocator and COMMIT only zero diffs. Faults roll back whole set; no public partial visibility. Prepared public/CI routes use pinned selector; raw legacy-current paths deny, historical read requires SHA. Exact proof alone enables receipt publication; no fallback/dual-write.

S5 — Actual migration/control/supervision tests: N1 buildMigrationManifest, N2 transformLegacyWork, N3 commitMigration, exact literal titles. Full checked id set plus all phase fixture rows, last-id dependency/scope/receipt/action tampering, lock/barrier/crash/restart, isolated Work and cross-cwd public/raw routing. Missing merge proof diagnostic cannot publish. Mandatory selected-profile commands, zero skip; legacy tests use frozen fixtures and current CI V2. Independent judgment/merge/Living checks stay intact; no live fixture cutover.
S6 — Verify live receipt/all ids/routing, release freeze; BB-156 delivery needs original approved candidate+real cutover/main/tree/Living proof through V2. No legacy writes.

snapshotContract.predicate: DONE always excluded. Withdrawal only status BLOCKED with exact bracketed prefix [WITHDRAWN ...] matching trusted title; all other unfinished statuses included, including non-withdrawn BLOCKED. Unknown/malformed withdrawal status/title combinations fail WITHDRAWAL_AMBIGUOUS. Reject references to excluded withdrawn dependencies. Included-id union excluded sets equals entire snapshot task id set, disjoint and unique.
snapshotContract.freeze: Selected adapter GithubMainFreeze in main-freeze.mjs: operator-owned GitHub token locks main through branch protection lock_branch=true/enforce_admins=true, with force/deletion/bypass disabled and existing protection retained. If repository policy cannot enforce lock or credentials lack permission, fail before capture. GET confirms locked protection and exact main SHA; service appends freeze receipt {repo,mainSha,protectionDigest,nonce,held,authorityRevision}. Drain/reconcile legacy claims and provider callbacks before capturing closure. Lock remains until postcommit verification or explicit abort restores saved protection. No SQLite transaction is claimed to lock Git; remote lock observation and operator ownership are explicit prerequisites.
snapshotContract.storage: Fetch exact Git objects and refs before freeze; resolve via git show SHA:path and actual blob modes, never current checkout files. Evidence/log/receipt closure hashes checked; required external blobs must be retained and readable. Research baseline count is only a historical calibration fixture. Worker enumerates a fresh locked snapshot at execution.
snapshotContract.barrier: Before capture, service maintenance CAS sets durable freeze nonce/revision and rejects actor allocation/publication/renewal plus reconciliation writes in both isolated V2 and legacy-current adapters, leaving readers available. Only operator freeze/migration actions are allowed. Native GitHub main lock is then confirmed and legacy claims/callbacks drained. Pre-existing V2 Work set is hash-bound and cannot change during capture/commit; failed native lock restores barrier/protection without import. Postcommit or explicit abort releases maintenance only after verification. No clock/ownership fact is manufactured.
snapshotContract.quiesce: Pause new legacy admission, finish normal publications on unlocked main, require zero active legacy claims/callbacks; then hard maintenance/native main lock and fresh recheck. Race aborts; no synthetic cleanup. Existing isolated V2 set hash-bound after hard barrier.

transformContract.spec: Strict generation1 Work uses the delivered BB-155 resource schema, including resourceVersion1, inline objective/plan semantic hashes, preserved id/dependencies/components/scopes/labels and exact snapshot provenance. Status holds activeAttemptRef/activeLeaseRef/candidateVersionRef/evidenceVersionRef/readinessDecisionRef/latestCandidateDecisionRef/repairReflectionRef/deliveryReceiptRef only as applicable; no mutable arrays in Attempt. ResolveImportedAuthority accepts migration-role LegacyImportReceipt as a typed bridge for original independent readiness/candidate receipts; it cannot overwrite their original answers/stateHash/cacheKey. No legacy pathname becomes current authority.
phaseMap: RESEARCH_SA/RESEARCH -> RESEARCHING, no READY condition; may research ahead of dependencies
RESEARCH_SA/JUDGMENT -> PLAN_JUDGMENT with exact objective/plan pending subject; new store-clock read-only controller Research Attempt/lease may own continuation, no fabricated readiness
WORKER/EXECUTION -> READY with validated imported readiness, dependencies expressed as blockers; old unused candidate pointers carry no candidate judgment authority

WORKER/JUDGMENT -> JUDGING with validated readiness and exact candidate/evidence pending subject; no in-flight callback at freeze. New read-only controller Attempt/lease binds imported inputs and requests fresh independent V2 judgment; no pending Decision is fabricated.

WORKER/MERGE_PENDING -> MERGE_PENDING with exact original accepted candidate via typed bridge; readonly VERIFY_MERGE diagnostic; PUBLISH_DELIVERY_RECEIPT enabled only after actual main/candidate/tree/Living proof. No source repair, fabricated native Decision or new judge answer.
WORKER/REPAIR -> REPAIRING only when delivered controller supports exact legacy current repair authority including BB-157 reflection; otherwise parity blocker
Non-withdrawn BLOCKED -> BLOCKED preserving explicit blockers/no automatic claim
DONE/withdrawn -> no Work; active claim status -> drain/precondition failure, never fabricate lease
